fixture.name: stock-bot
setup: graph-agents-cli api add inventory_rpc --protocol jsonrpc --base-url-env INVENTORY_RPC_URL --auth bearer --token-env INVENTORY_RPC_TOKEN --access custom --methods POST

prompt: In stock-bot/, the inventory JSON-RPC API must accept only the two methods our tools use, item.get and item.search, at POST /rpc. item.delete must be refused outright, whatever path or label a call gives it. Don't change the tools.

checks.expr: (lambda ops: bool(ops) and all(isinstance(o, dict) and o.get('rpc_method') in ('item.get', 'item.search') and o.get('path') == '/rpc' and [str(m).upper() for m in (o.get('methods') or [])] == ['POST'] for o in ops) and {o.get('rpc_method') for o in ops} == {'item.get', 'item.search'})(get(data, 'apis.inventory_rpc.allowed_operations') or [])
checks.why: on a JSON-RPC API every call is a POST to one endpoint: an entry without rpc_method allows every method there (`api allow NAME --rpc-method M --method POST --path /rpc`)

checks.expr: any(isinstance(d, dict) and str(d.get('rpc_method', '')).lower() == 'item.delete' and not d.get('path') and not d.get('operationId') and not d.get('methods') for d in (get(data, 'apis.inventory_rpc.denied_operations') or []))
checks.why: a denial by rpc_method alone refuses the method whatever the path or label (`api deny NAME --rpc-method item.delete`)

reference: `graph-agents-cli api allow inventory_rpc --rpc-method item.get --method POST --path /rpc`, the same for item.search, and `graph-agents-cli api deny inventory_rpc --rpc-method item.delete` (each with --dry-run first). The client reads the JSON-RPC method from the request body, so the entries judge the call by it; an allow entry by path alone would allow every method at /rpc. Tools unchanged; `lint` passes.
